For the overflow, `strncmp(lexer->pos, end, 3)` needs `lexer->pos` to be at or near `static_data + 32768` (the end of the global buffer). But `lexer->end = static_data + 32767`, and `next()` returns '\0' when `pos >= end`, i.e., when pos >= 32767.
